description: Something done in a chat, as an app saw it happen: kept by its machine's host as it's told (telemetry), read back with telemetry_read. A chat is named by its host's id and its session's id, so what every host keeps can be put together.

at.description: When, in seconds since the epoch (to the millisecond).

app.description: What saw it: Baude, Record, the phone's app, or the chat's host itself (a turn's end, as it ran there: what tokens are added up from).

kind.description: What happened: a chat opened in a window or screen; a chat came in front (its window or screen in front, showing it, with someone at the machine); it stopped being in front (or nobody's at the machine now); a turn sent in it; a turn of it ended.

host.description: The id of the host the chat is on.

seconds.description: A turn_ended's: how long the turn took.

turn.description: A turn_ended's: the id of the turn's result, so a turn two apps saw end is counted once.

model.description: A turn_ended's: the model it ran on.

effort.description: A turn_ended's: the effort it ran at.

tokens_in.description: A turn_ended's: the tokens it read (input, cache reads and writes).

tokens_out.description: A turn_ended's: the tokens it wrote.

commit.description: The commit the app that saw it runs (its first 12 characters), as it started.

wire.description: The wire's version the app that saw it speaks.
